description: This file implements a Speechmatics Text-to-Speech (TTS) service integration, providing classes and methods to generate speech audio from text using Speechmatics' HTTP API, with retry logic, streaming response handling, and metrics support.

classes.name: SpeechmaticsTTSService
classes.description: A class implementing a TTS service using Speechmatics API, supporting streaming synthesis, retries, and metrics.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: A nested class within SpeechmaticsTTSService defining optional input parameters such as max_retries.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Returns True, indicating the service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronously generates speech audio frames from input text, handling retries, streaming response, and error conditions.
